title: Clinking Curio Cuttlefish
statement: Nestled among sunken slate arches and swaying ink-kelp, this pint-sized cephalopod spends its days sorting frosted sea glass into neat, musical spirals across the sandy floor. Whenever a curious visitor leans close, it pauses its quiet clinking to ripple intricate, shifting constellations of warm bioluminescent light across its velvety skin in greeting.
